title: 功率因數校正電路
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討線電流成形、功率因數、諧波與雙迴路控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore line-current shaping, power factor, harmonics and dual-loop control, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。市電與併網測試需合格設備及專業作業；本課只用離線波形，不提供市電接線或安規認證保證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Mains/interconnection testing needs qualified equipment and professionals; this course uses offline waveforms without wiring instructions or certification claims.

stages.title: 功率與諧波

stages.descriptionEn: Complete power and harmonics through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解定義真功率因數，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 對尖峰電流波形算 RMS 和平均功率，檢查相位同相仍可能低 PF。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.

knowledge.title: 定義真功率因數：原理
knowledge.text: PF=P/(VrmsIrms)，不同於只看基波相角的位移因數。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍

knowledge.text: 教學例：輸出 1 kW、效率 95%、輸入 230 Vrms、真功率因數 0.99，Irms=Pout/(ηVrmsPF)=4.62 A。若在相同效率下 PF=0.70，Irms≈6.54 A，線路 I²R 約增至 2 倍。 市電與併網測試需合格設備及專業作業；本課只用離線波形，不提供市電接線或安規認證保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 1 kW output at 95% efficiency, 230 Vrms and true PF 0.99 requires Irms=Pout/(ηVrmsPF)=4.62 A. At PF 0.70 with the same efficiency, Irms≈6.54 A and line I²R is about twice as high. Mains/interconnection testing needs qualified equipment and professionals; this course uses offline waveforms without wiring instructions or certification claims.

steps.title: 分離效率與 PF：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Separate efficiency and PF: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分離效率與 PF，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate efficiency and pf through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「高 PF 不代表低轉換損耗，高效率也不保證低諧波。」的觀察。把效率、PF 和 THD 三項各自放到本課電流算例旁。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: High PF does not imply low conversion loss; high efficiency does not ensure low harmonics. List efficiency, PF and THD separately beside the input-current example. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 把效率、PF 和 THD 三項各自放到本課電流算例旁。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: List efficiency, PF and THD separately beside the input-current example. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分離效率與 PF」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把線電流成形、功率因數、諧波與雙迴路控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate efficiency and pf disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of line-current shaping, power factor, harmonics and dual-loop control behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分離效率與 PF」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate efficiency and pf, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
